flashcard_questions.q: The smallest structural and functional unit of a living organism.
A group of similar cells that work together to carry out a particular function.
A structure made up of a group of different tissues working together to perform a specific function.

flashcard_questions.a: A group of organs that work together to carry out a major body function, such as the digestive system.
Biological catalysts that speed up chemical reactions in living organisms. Each enzyme has a specific active site that fits only one substrate.
